questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with inversion for emphasis.

The committee's decision was announced late last night.

Which of the following correctly emphasizes the time aspect?
options: It was announced late last night by the committee.
Announced late last night, the committee's decision was made.
Late last night, the committee announced its decision.
The committee announced, late last night, its decision.
questions.answer: Late last night, the committee announced its decision.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the location of the discovery?

Archaeologists discovered a Roman coin in the garden.

Which option correctly isolates the location?
options: It was in the garden that archaeologists discovered a Roman coin.
The discovery was a Roman coin, found in the garden.
In the garden, archaeologists discovered a Roman coin.
A Roman coin was discovered in the garden by archaeologists.
questions.answer: It was in the garden that archaeologists discovered a Roman coin.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the subjunctive in the following sentence.

If only we _______ the opportunity to explore the Amazon rainforest next year!

Which verb form completes the sentence correctly?
options: had had
had
were to have
could have

questions.question:
Identify the correct use of ellipsis in the following context.

The team completed the project yesterday. The management, however, was not satisfied.

Which of the following correctly combines these sentences using ellipsis?
options: The team completed the project yesterday, management was not satisfied.
The team completed the project yesterday, however, management was not satisfied.
The team completed the project yesterday, but management was not satisfied.
The team completed the project yesterday, so management was not satisfied.
questions.answer: The team completed the project yesterday, however, management was not satisfied.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a formal register with complex sentence structure to express a conditional assumption?

Provided that the research data _______ by the deadline, the grant committee will review the proposal.

Which verb form is appropriate for the formal context?
options: is submitted
has been submitted
had been submitted
were submitted
